NOTIFICATION_HOOK.compositionNote: Panel contained at full width; face, phone and notification card all preserved, nothing cropped.
NOTIFICATION_HOOK.animationPerformed: slow cinematic push toward the face and phone, with a brand-red accent ring pulsing once around the notification card from 0.24s for 0.46s, synchronised to the notification cue
NOTIFICATION_HOOK.remainingMismatch: The storyboard's converging red radial energy around the device is delivered as a single rectangular accent ring rather than as concentric radial energy; no radial-energy primitive exists in the catalogue.
NOTIFICATION_HOOK.missingProductionAsset: A live-action talent plate with a phone in hand under red rim light, plus a real notification-card graphic.

COMBAT_SPORT_BREADTH.compositionNote: Panel contained at full width; all five discipline slices and the centred headline preserved.
COMBAT_SPORT_BREADTH.animationPerformed: the panel's own five vertical slices revealed left to right across the first 60% of the scene, so the row assembles rhythmically and the headline resolves with the final slice
COMBAT_SPORT_BREADTH.remainingMismatch: The slices are revealed rather than moving footage; each is a still, because no licensed clip exists for any of the five disciplines.
COMBAT_SPORT_BREADTH.missingProductionAsset: Five licensed discipline clips: boxing, MMA, Muay Thai, kickboxing and grappling.

EVENT_DISCOVERY.compositionNote: Panel contained at full width; phone left, arena right, two-line headline all preserved.
EVENT_DISCOVERY.animationPerformed: parallax depth between the backplate and the contained panel, with a focus dim isolating the events interface from 0.42s for 0.85s so the screen stays the thing being read
EVENT_DISCOVERY.remainingMismatch: Foreground phone, arena and background are separated into two planes rather than three, because the panel is a single flattened image and no per-element mattes exist.
EVENT_DISCOVERY.missingProductionAsset: A real Combat Reviews events capture matching this panel's event list, and an arena plate.

RANKINGS_RESEARCH.compositionNote: Panel contained at full width; headline left, rankings phone right, ordered list preserved.
RANKINGS_RESEARCH.animationPerformed: restrained push settling on the rankings phone, with a focus dim isolating the ordered list from 0.30s for 0.75s so the motion reads as research
RANKINGS_RESEARCH.remainingMismatch: The ranking rows do not reveal individually; they are baked into the panel, and row-level animation would require the rows as separate assets.
RANKINGS_RESEARCH.missingProductionAsset: A real Combat Reviews fighter-rankings capture. The available capture is the challenge leaderboard, which is a different screen.

FIGHTER_COMPARISON.compositionNote: Panel contained at full width; symmetrical face-off and centred comparison card preserved.
FIGHTER_COMPARISON.animationPerformed: steady push drawing both fighters and the comparison card toward the viewer, holding the symmetry the panel composed
FIGHTER_COMPARISON.remainingMismatch: The two fighters push together with the whole frame rather than toward one another, and the records and recent-form markers do not reveal progressively; both would need the fighters and the card as separate layers.
FIGHTER_COMPARISON.missingProductionAsset: Licensed fighter portrait plates and a real comparison capture.

FREE_PREDICTION.compositionNote: Panel contained at full width; headline left, prediction phone right, selected card, check and reaching finger preserved.
FREE_PREDICTION.animationPerformed: deliberately restrained push so the interface stays legible, with a tap indicator landing on the free-prediction button at 0.54s for 0.38s, synchronised to the selection click
FREE_PREDICTION.remainingMismatch: The selection state is already resolved in the panel, so the card glow and the button depression cannot animate from unselected to selected; the tap indicator and its sound carry the interaction instead.
FREE_PREDICTION.missingProductionAsset: A real Combat Reviews prediction capture in both unselected and selected states, and a hand plate.

PREDICTION_SUBMITTED.compositionNote: Panel contained at full width; bell, both fighters, referee and the confirmation pill preserved. The pill's label was corrected in the panel's own design.
PREDICTION_SUBMITTED.animationPerformed: hardest push in the cut, entered on an impact cut, with a full-frame brand-red confirmation flash for the first 0.20s landing on the bell and impact cues together
PREDICTION_SUBMITTED.remainingMismatch: The bell does not swing and the strike does not land; the panel is a single frame, so the impact is carried by the flash, the push and the audio rather than by movement in the image.
PREDICTION_SUBMITTED.missingProductionAsset: A licensed bell or fight-start plate with real movement.

PREDICTOR_STATUS_REWARD.compositionNote: Panel contained at full width; celebration left, result card with the tick and the rank movement right, headline preserved.

PREDICTOR_STATUS_REWARD.remainingMismatch: The rank movement is static in the panel rather than counting up, and no particles rise; both would need the card as a separate animated layer.
PREDICTOR_STATUS_REWARD.missingProductionAsset: A licensed celebration plate and a real predictor-status capture. The rank movement shown is illustrative concept UI.

COMMUNITY_DISCUSSION.compositionNote: Panel contained at full width; two fans left, discussion phone right, threaded feed and headline preserved.
